title: Level 601 - "The End"
physical_identity: A seemingly endless modern library, near silent, with a central area of metal letters spelling 'the end is near' and loud computer terminals. A trap level that fakes escape.
scale_topology: Endless indoor library with unstable geometry; personalised 'fake reality' sub-areas close together.
anomalies: Looping walk; turning around meets a wall
lighting_sound: Near complete silence, some areas -6.2 dB; central computer terminals buzz loudly. Light not stated.
